{"relevant": true, "severity": "warn", "message": "web/src/auth.ts: storing the JWT in localStorage exposes it to any XSS, since a single injected script can read and exfiltrate the token and take over the session. Fix: set it in an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax/Strict cookie from the /login handler in internal/auth/login.go (and add CSRF protection if using cookies), rather than returning it in the JSON body. Also check login.go for: constant-time password comparison via bcrypt/argon2, a generic error for bad user/password (no user enumeration), rate limiting/lockout on /login to stop credential stuffing, a short `exp` claim, an explicit signing-algorithm check on verify (reject `none`/alg confusion), and the secret loaded from env/secret store, not hardcoded."}
